definitions.explanation: The correct or right answer to a question or problem.
Being correct or right about something.

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正解|せいかい}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{全問|ぜんもん}→全問：27469_zenmon⟧{正解|せいかい}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I got all the answers right.

notes:
{正解|せいかい} combines ⟦{正|せい}→正：noentry⟧ (correct) + ⟦{解|かい}→解：noentry⟧ (answer/solution).
